name: Tomotik
tagline: Websites & web apps that win you customers.
description: Tomotik is an independent web design & development studio. We build fast, modern websites and web apps for small businesses — fixed quotes, honest timelines, and everything delivered in your name.

services.title: Websites & landing pages
services.summary: Marketing sites that load fast, read clearly, and make it easy to contact you. Designed and built by the same hands — no handoffs, no telephone game.
points: Lead forms wired to your inbox

services.title: Web apps & portals
services.summary: Dashboards, admin panels, and client portals on a modern stack — the internal tools and logged-in experiences your business actually runs on.

services.title: Care & improvements
services.summary: Already live? We keep sites healthy and improving month to month — fixes, updates, speed work, and a steady stream of small wins.

process.title: Scope
process.body: A free 30-minute call about your goals, budget, and timeline. You get a fixed written quote within two business days — no obligation.

process.title: Design
process.body: We design the key screens first and revise together until they feel right. Two revision rounds are built into every quote.

process.title: Build
process.body: Clean, typed code with a live preview link from the first week — you watch progress instead of waiting on it.

process.title: Launch
process.body: We deploy, hand over every password and file, and walk you through your admin. Bugs are on us for 30 days after launch.

pricing.name: Launch
pricing.summary: A focused marketing site for a business that needs to look right and start converting.
features: Contact & quote forms to your inbox

pricing.name: Build
pricing.summary: A full web application: accounts, dashboards, and the tools your business runs on.

pricing.name: Partner
pricing.summary: Ongoing design + development for a site or product that needs to keep moving.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: Most marketing sites we build land between $1,900 and $5,000 depending on pages and features; web apps start around $6,500. Every project gets a fixed written quote before we start — the price you approve is the price you pay.
A marketing site typically takes 2–3 weeks, a web app 4–8. The timeline is agreed in your quote, and you get a live preview link from the first week so you can see progress for yourself.

faqs.q: What do you need from me?
faqs.a: Roughly two hours in total: a kickoff call, your logo and any content you already have, and feedback at the design and pre-launch checkpoints. Missing copy or images? We'll draft and source them with you.
Yes. The domain, hosting, code, and content all live in accounts registered in your name. When the final invoice is paid you hold every password and file — nothing about your site depends on us.

50% to book your start date, 50% at launch. Monthly plans are simple monthly billing you can pause or cancel anytime. If scope changes mid-project, we quote the change in writing before doing the work.
Every project includes 30 days of free bug fixes. After that, you can run things yourself — we hand over docs and a walkthrough — or move to a Partner plan and we keep improving it for you.
